coordinate_units.cell_fraction: fraction of the historical base cell width

title: 8 periodic initial conditions
description: Eight distinct nonstationary zero-winding periodic orbits, numerically verified at rho=0.30 for the reflected potential.

verification.distance_convention: Unwrapped Euclidean closure in normalized base-cell coordinates; zero winding.
verification.minimum_period_test: All integer forcing-cycle returns before the claimed period.
verification.distinctness_test: All pairs of cycle returns, allowing phase shifts and period-two spatial copies; separation > 1e-4.
verification.qualification: Numerical verification at the stated finite resolutions; not a rigorous existence proof.
